## File: huggingface_api-inference-community/scripts/export_tasks.py

Prompts

```
['run the script to export a library to supported tasks mapping in JSON format', 'traverse all global assignments in a Python file and apply a handler callback to each', "extract supported task keys from an ALLOWED_TASKS variable in a library's source code", "summarize the library to task mapping defaultdict that stores each library's supported tasks", 'review the traverse_global_assignments function that parses AST and handles both annotated and plain assignments']
```

Usage

```
{'run_export_tasks': 'run the script to export a library to supported tasks mapping in JSON format', 'traverse_global_assignments': 'traverse all global assignments in a Python file and apply a handler callback to each', 'extract_tasks': "extract supported task keys from an ALLOWED_TASKS variable in a library's source code", 'summarize_lib_to_task_map': "summarize the library to task mapping defaultdict that stores each library's supported tasks", 'review_traverse_global_assignments': 'review the traverse_global_assignments function that parses AST and handles both annotated and plain assignments'}
```
